title: export-creative-performance-to-google-sheet — export request
description: What the operator asks to export and where. The scope is always explicit (client_ids and/or report paths) — never an implicit 'all clients'. The destination must be a writable scope 'bu' entry of the BU registry (<workspace>/bu/sources.json) whose allowed_client_ids cover every exported client.

export_id.description: Operator-chosen id; patch ids derive from it (cpx-<export_id>-structure|content).

spreadsheet_id.description: Optional cross-check: id or docs.google.com URL; names are never searched.

client_ids.description: Every final creative-performance.json of each listed client (explicit per-client request).
